title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Middle innings with a lead
hook: You are winning after three innings. What do you say?
intro: The team is up by five runs.
statement: A lead is a good time to work on something new.
q1: Do you set a new goal for the next few innings —
q2: or keep things the same and let them enjoy it?
q3: What could they practice with a cushion?
t1: There is no single right way. But late innings stay sharp
t2: when there is still something to work on.
cta: Coaches — what do you say with a lead?
ctaLines: New goal. Rotate positions. Keep playing our way.
Change it up or keep it?
ctaPrompt: Share your dugout habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
You are winning after three innings. What do you say?
The team is up by five runs. Everyone is relaxed and laughing.
A lead is a good time to work on something new.
Set a new goal or keep it the same. Every team is different.
What do you say with a lead? Share your habit in the comments.
